correctness.rationale: Each square-zero rank-a operator is determined by a flag U=im X subset K=ker X of dimensions a,n-a and an isomorphism V/K→U, giving Z_a=[n a]_q[n-a a]_q |GL_a(q)|. For Y use flag S⊂W and an isomorphism V/W→S. Because X,Y inject on quotients, r=rank(XY)=b−dim(S∩K) and s=rank(YX)=a−dim(U∩W). With c=dim(S∩U), d=b−r−c, e=n−2b−a+s+c, subspace intersection counts and graph-of-map lifts yield the formula in RESULT.md; no overlap of flag choices. Nonempty integer index set reduces exactly to |r−s|≤n−a−b, and for n=2h,a=b=h enforces r=s. Independently evaluated Gaussian coefficients giving F_(3,2)(1,1;r,s)=[105,84,84,168] in lexicographic (r,s), F_(4,2)(2,2;r,r)=[1260,22680,20160], and exact all-fiber normalization for 1≤n≤7 at q=2. Arbitrary-field statement follows from flag counting, not these finite cases.
